references.text: Psalm 2:8 refers to God's promise to give the nations as an inheritance, which reflects Jesus' authority over heaven and earth in Matthew 28:18.
Daniel 7:13-14 describes the Son of Man receiving all power, glory, and kingdom, foreshadowing Jesus' declaration of all authority in heaven and on earth.
Matthew 11:27 highlights Jesus' unique relationship with the Father and his authority to reveal the Father, consistent with his omnipotence in Matthew 28:18.
John 3:35 speaks of the Father loving the Son and having given all things into his hand, corresponding with Jesus' power in Matthew 28:18.
John 13:3 emphasizes that Jesus knew the Father had given all things into his hands, reflecting his authority in Matthew 28:18.
Philippians 2:9-11 describes how Jesus is exalted by God and given a name above every name, mirroring his universal authority in Matthew 28:18.
